description:
About our brand and products:
The Roo Co is a luxury clean candle brand built around the idea that your home should smell as intentional as it looks. Every candle is hand-poured in small batches using a coconut-soy blend, wooden wicks, and phthalate-free fragrance oils. We make slow living tangible. Our candles are the kind of thing people notice the moment they walk into a room and ask about before they even say hello.

What makes us different:
We are not a mass-produced candle brand. Every batch is limited, every scent is hand-poured in the US with clean ingredients, and every product is built to last 60 hours or more. Our aesthetic sits at the intersection of editorial luxury and everyday ritual. Think Aesop meets Le Labo meets your dream apartment. Our customers are intentional men and women who treat their homes as sanctuaries and buy with purpose. They are loyal, they repurchase, and they tell their friends.

How affiliates can earn:
Brand Insiders start at 20% commission on every sale from day one with no minimums required. Hit $500 in monthly referred sales and your rate automatically increases to 25%. Make your first three sales and receive a $25 welcome bonus on top of your commissions. Generate $300 in monthly referred sales and we ship you a complimentary candle set every month for up to six months. Commissions are paid every two weeks.

How to promote us:
Our product is built for content. The packaging is editorial, the scents have stories, and every candle photographs beautifully across every format. Brand Insiders receive pre-written captions, hooks, talking points, content ideas, and marketing assets from day one. Whether you create morning routine content, home styling videos, slow living reels, or cozy lifestyle posts, this product fits naturally into content you are already making. We also provide early access to new scents and drops so you always have something fresh to film.

Other information:
Every application is personally reviewed. We keep the program small on purpose so we can work closely with every creator in it. Spots are limited. We care about beautiful content and genuine recommendations far more than follower count. If your audience trusts you and your aesthetic aligns with elevated home living, we want you in.
payout_period: Commissions are paid every two weeks. Payments are processed on the 1st and 15th of each month and sent directly to your account. You can track your earnings in real time through your personal affiliate dashboard at any time.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to The Roo Co Brand Insider Program.

These terms and conditions apply to individuals accessing or participating in The Roo Co Affiliate Program, both as a merchant ("we" or "The Roo Co") and an affiliate ("you" or "Brand Insider") who refers customers to purchase products from The Roo Co.

By participating in the Program, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions in their entirety. If you do not agree, you are not authorized to register as an affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any affiliate application in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your application. Every application is reviewed to ensure it is a genuine fit for The Roo Co brand and community.

2. Commission Structure

You will earn a 20% commission on every successfully completed order placed through your unique affiliate link from day one. No minimums required to get started.

Reach $500 in monthly referred sales and your commission rate will automatically increase to 25%.

Commission is calculated based on the order subtotal and does not include taxes, shipping costs, or any additional fees. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be eligible for commission.

3. Bonuses and Perks

Welcome Bonus: Complete your first three referred sales and receive a $25 bonus added on top of your standard commissions. This is our way of rewarding creators who hit the ground running.

Free Candles: Generate at least $300 in monthly referred sales and we will ship you a complimentary Roo Co candle set every month for up to six months.

These perks are subject to review and may be updated from time to time. Any changes will be communicated to active affiliates in advance.

4. Payment Schedule

Commissions are paid every two weeks. To receive payment, you must have your payment details completed under Settings in your affiliate dashboard. Payments are only processed for transactions that have been successfully completed and are not subject to any open disputes, chargebacks, or refunds.

5. Affiliate Links and Coupon Codes

Upon approval, you will receive a unique affiliate link. You may also generate links for specific products or collections through your dashboard. If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links, the most recent click will be credited.

You may or may not be assigned a branded coupon code. If a customer uses both your affiliate link and a coupon code, you will receive commission on one, not both. If you have not been assigned a coupon code, you are not permitted to promote one.

You may promote The Roo Co on online channels including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, and YouTube, as well as offline channels such as print publications.

6. Marketing Assets

Upon approval, you will receive access to content templates, captions, hooks, talking points, and marketing assets through your onboarding guide. Additional promotional materials may be shared through the Marketing tab in your dashboard from time to time.

7. Cookie Tracking

We use cookies to track customers who click your affiliate link. Tracking begins at the moment a customer clicks your link or uses your coupon code. Within the cookie window, any order placed by that customer on The Roo Co website will automatically generate a commission for you. If a customer clears their cookies or does not permit cookie tracking, we are unable to attribute that activity to your account.

The cookie tracking window is specified on your affiliate registration form.

8. Fair Use

Use of the Brand Insider Program is subject to a fair use policy. We reserve the right to review any referral order and withhold or reverse commissions in cases of fraudulent activity, self-referrals, or abuse of the program.

9. Removal from the Program

If you wish to be removed from the Brand Insider Program at any time, please contact us at help@therooco.com. We reserve the right to remove any affiliate from the program at our discretion if these terms are violated.

If you have any questions about these terms, reach out to us at help@therooco.com. We are glad to have you as part of The Roo Co community and look forward to building something great together.
